class: Any decision-support wording guard (ADR-003) written as its own exact-substring list inside each module lets word-stem and spacing variants of banned advice through, and the separate lists drift apart, so the same banned sentence passes in one module and fails in another.
mechanism: Each builder wrote a fresh list of exact phrases ('guaranteed', 'recommended trade', 'risk-free', 'you should'); the scans compared lowercased substrings without normalising spaces or stems.
